```{r}
rna_df <- read.csv("rna_for_seurat.csv", check.names = FALSE)
# Drop the first 6 metadata columns
gene_mat <- as.matrix(rna_df[, -(1:6)])

# Make sure rows = cells, cols = genes
dim(gene_mat)
```
```{r}
rna_df
```

```{r}
meta <- rna_df[, 1:6]
set.seed(123)
# 2️⃣ Subsample 100 cells per (treatment, dosage, time)
meta$cell_index <- 1:nrow(meta)

meta_balanced <- meta %>%
  group_by(treatment, dosage, time) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 100, replace = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Subset the gene matrix
gene_mat_balanced <- gene_mat[meta_balanced$cell_index, ]

# Check dimensions
dim(gene_mat_balanced)
# [1] (groups × 100) × 338

# 3️⃣ Fit Poisson NMF
K <- 16  # number of topics
# fit <- fit_poisson_nmf(gene_mat_balanced, k = K, numiter = 100, verbose = "detailed")
# 
# # 4️⃣ Convert to multinomial representation (LDA-style)
# fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(fit)

tm <- fit_poisson_nmf(gene_mat_balanced,k = 16,init.method = "random",method = "em",
                      numiter = 20,verbose = "none",
					  control = list(numiter = 4,nc = 8,extrapolate = FALSE))
tm <- fit_poisson_nmf(gene_mat_balanced,fit0 = tm,method = "scd",numiter = 40,
                      control = list(numiter = 4,nc = 8,extrapolate = TRUE),
					  verbose = "none")
fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(tm)

# 5️⃣ Optional: Extract matrices
theta <- fit_multinom$L  # cell-topic proportions (N × K)
beta  <- fit_multinom$F  # topic–gene weights (G × K)

# 6️⃣ Save metadata + topic loadings
theta_df <- cbind(meta_balanced, theta)

# Quick check
print(dim(theta_df))
print(head(theta_df[, 1:10]))
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1) Grab cell–topic proportions (N x K)
theta <- fit_multinom$L
stopifnot(nrow(theta) == nrow(meta_balanced))

# 2) Logit transform (topic vs rest): Z_ik = log(theta_ik / (1 - theta_ik))
eps <- 1e-6
theta_safe <- pmin(pmax(theta, eps), 1 - eps)   # clamp away from 0 and 1

theta_logit <- log(theta_safe / (1 - theta_safe))   # N x K

# (optional but recommended) row-center to emphasize relative patterns per cell
# theta_logit <- scale(theta_logit, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)

# 3) Build annotation dataframe (one row per cell)
ann_col <- data.frame(
  treatment  = factor(meta_balanced$treatment),
  dosage     = factor(meta_balanced$dosage),
  time       = factor(meta_balanced$time),
  cell_state = factor(meta_balanced$cell_state)
)
rownames(ann_col) <- rownames(theta_logit)

# 4) Define annotation colors
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = ann_col,
  col = list(
    treatment = structure(
      brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$treatment)), "Set2"),
      names = levels(ann_col$treatment)
    ),
    dosage = structure(
      brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$dosage)), "Set1"),
      names = levels(ann_col$dosage)
    ),
    time = structure(
      brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$time)), "Set3"),
      names = levels(ann_col$time)
    ),
    cell_state = structure(
      brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$cell_state)), "Dark2"),
      names = levels(ann_col$cell_state)
    )
  )
)

# 5) Name topics for display
colnames(theta_logit) <- paste0("T", seq_len(ncol(theta_logit)))  # or your real topic names

# 6) Draw the heatmap
ht_opt$message <- FALSE

# pick a robust color range (avoids a few extreme logits dominating)
rng <- quantile(abs(theta_logit), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

Heatmap(
  t(theta_logit),   # rows = topics, cols = cells
  name = "logit(theta)",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-rng, 0, rng), c("#2b8cbe", "white", "#e34a33")),
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  top_annotation = ha,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  use_raster = FALSE,          # usually better for many cells
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title = "Cells (logit topic proportion: topic vs rest)",
  row_title = "Topics"
)

```


```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1) proportions: N x K
theta <- fit_multinom$L
stopifnot(nrow(theta) == nrow(meta_balanced))

# # (optional) ensure numeric and in [0,1]
# theta <- as.matrix(theta)
# theta <- pmax(theta, 0)
# theta <- theta / rowSums(theta)

# 2) annotations (one row per cell)
ann_col <- data.frame(
  treatment  = factor(meta_balanced$treatment),
  dosage     = factor(meta_balanced$dosage),
  time       = factor(meta_balanced$time),
  cell_state = factor(meta_balanced$cell_state)
)
rownames(ann_col) <- rownames(theta)  # <- IMPORTANT: align

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = ann_col,
  col = list(
    treatment  = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$treatment)), "Set2"),  levels(ann_col$treatment)),
    dosage     = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$dosage)),    "Set1"),  levels(ann_col$dosage)),
    time       = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$time)),      "Set3"),  levels(ann_col$time)),
    cell_state = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_col$cell_state)),"Dark2"), levels(ann_col$cell_state))
  )
)

# 3) topic names
colnames(theta) <- paste0("T", seq_len(ncol(theta)))

# 4) color scale for proportions
# Use robust upper bound so a few high cells don’t saturate everything
q_hi <- quantile(theta, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, q_hi/4, q_hi/2, q_hi), c("white", "#deebf7", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd"))

ht_opt$message <- FALSE

Heatmap(
  t(theta),                     # rows = topics, cols = cells
  name = "theta",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = ha,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  use_raster = FALSE,           # avoids the blob error
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title = "Cells (topic proportions)",
  row_title = "Topics"
)

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1) theta: N x K
theta <- as.matrix(fit_multinom$L)
stopifnot(nrow(theta) == nrow(meta_balanced))
colnames(theta) <- paste0("T", seq_len(ncol(theta)))

# optional safety: renormalize
theta <- pmax(theta, 0)
theta <- theta / rowSums(theta)

# 2) build df: meta + theta
theta_df <- bind_cols(
  meta_balanced %>%
    transmute(
      treatment  = factor(treatment),
      dosage     = factor(dosage),
      time       = factor(time),
      cell_state = factor(cell_state)
    ),
  as.data.frame(theta)
)

# 3) group mean (this still contains meta cols + T cols)
theta_group <- theta_df %>%
  group_by(treatment, dosage, time, cell_state) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("T"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# 4) make group IDs (for column names + annotation alignment)
group_ids <- theta_group %>%
  transmute(group_id = paste(treatment, dosage, time, cell_state, sep = "_")) %>%
  pull(group_id)

# 5) IMPORTANT: matrix must include ONLY topic columns
theta_group_mat <- theta_group %>%
  select(starts_with("T")) %>%
  as.matrix()
storage.mode(theta_group_mat) <- "double"

rownames(theta_group_mat) <- group_ids

# heatmap matrix: topics x groups
theta_group_t <- t(theta_group_mat)

topic_cols <- grep("^T\\d+$", names(theta_group), value = TRUE)

theta_group_mat <- as.matrix(theta_group[, topic_cols, drop = FALSE])
storage.mode(theta_group_mat) <- "double"

theta_group_t <- t(theta_group_mat)


# 6) column annotation (one per group)
ann_group <- theta_group %>%
  transmute(
    treatment  = factor(treatment),
    dosage     = factor(dosage),
    time       = factor(time),
    cell_state = factor(cell_state)
  )
rownames(ann_group) <- group_ids

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = ann_group,
  col = list(
    treatment  = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_group$treatment)), "Set2"),  levels(ann_group$treatment)),
    dosage     = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_group$dosage)),    "Set1"),  levels(ann_group$dosage)),
    time       = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_group$time)),      "Set3"),  levels(ann_group$time)),
    cell_state = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(ann_group$cell_state)),"Dark2"), levels(ann_group$cell_state))
  )
)

# 7) color scale based on group means
q_hi <- quantile(theta_group_t, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, q_hi/4, q_hi/2, q_hi),
                      c("white", "#deebf7", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd"))

ht_opt$message <- FALSE

Heatmap(
  theta_group_t,
  name = "mean(theta)",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = ha,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  use_raster = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title = "Groups (mean topic proportions)",
  row_title = "Topics"
)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

topic_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(K)

# optional: order cells by time (then within time by cell_state)
rows <- order(meta_balanced$time)

p_cellstate <- structure_plot(
  tm,
  grouping = factor(meta_balanced$cell_state),
  gap = 4,
  topics = 1:K,
  colors = topic_colors,
  loadings_order = rows
) +
  labs(fill = "") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.4))

p_cellstate

```
